name: Anacostia (Kingman Lake, Washington DC)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Late-summer Mid-Atlantic parkland turf (as potomac), sandy bunkers, and murky olive-brown water: the Anacostia and Kingman Lake are not blue (developer, 2026-10-19; reference/langston/lg02_kingman_lake.jpg). Trees: loblolly pine, oak, sycamore and willow, no blossoms (assets-src/trees_anacostia.py). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
